opportunities.title: VP of Product & Design
opportunities.source: Jobicy Public API — Trabajos Remotos Globales
opportunities.description: At Serve Robotics , we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. Who We Are We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. Lead a high-performing Product and Design team to build what the future looks like with robots by our side, starting with sidewalk logistics. This role is accountable for raising the bar, identifying high-impact opportunities and big bets, and clearly articulating the rationale behind where we’re going and why. This role partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Data, Business Development , Program Management, Safety, Policy, and other leaders to align priorities, navigate tradeoffs, and turn company strategy into clear, coordinated execution. Responsibilities Lead a High Performing Team Develop and uplevel a strong product management and design team and foster a culture for intellectual curiosity, measurable experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration. Set a high bar for product and design quality and craft and evolve how business opportunities, requirements, and validation are built, communicated, and maintained. Serve as a key member of the leadership team and contribute beyond the Product organization to company-wide strategy and execution. Establish clear roles, expectations, decision rights, and accountability across the organization. Product Vision and Narrative Deliver delight to customers and the public while expanding the sidewalk delivery business. Translate corporate strategy and customer needs into clear product priorities and investment decisions for both product and design. Develop a strong understanding of customers, users, competitors, and market dynamics to inform product direction and design principles.. Champion data-driven product decision making, using quantitative and qualitative insights to prioritize opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, and guide product strategy and investment. Balance near-term customer and operational needs with investments in scalable, long-term product capabilities. Ensure product development is grounded in real-world customer and user needs rather than technology development alone. Develop and maintain a clear product roadmap that translates company strategy and customer needs into prioritized product initiatives, milestones, and outcomes. Design & User Experience Lead the Design function and establish a cohesive design vision across the company's products and experiences. Champion user-centered design and ensure customer and end-user insights are incorporated throughout the development process. Shepherd scalable design practices, systems, and standards that create intuitive and consistent experiences cross-functionally. Build processes that enable Product, Engineering, Operations, and Commercial teams to collaborate in a fast-pace while delivering on delightful user experience Ensure design is treated as a strategic product capability and incorporated early in product development. Deliver on public safety-focused design from Industrial Design to Operational Tools Qualifications 12+ years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, design, or related technology leadership roles. 5+ years of experience leading and developing product teams, including experience managing senior product leaders and/or multidisciplinary organizations. Demonstrated experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for complex technology products from concept through commercialization and scale. Proven track record of translating company strategy, customer needs, and technical capabilities into clear product priorities and measurable business outcomes. Master communicator with experience partnering with executive leadership and communicating product, design and technical strategy to senior internal and external stakeholders. Strong people leadership capabilities with demonstrated success recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams. What Makes You Stand Out Experience developing products involving robotics, autonomous systems, artificial intelligence, mobility, logistics, or other complex hardware and software systems. Experience with products that operate in the physical world where safety, reliability, hardware constraints, operational performance, and user experience must be considered together. Experience leading or directly overseeing both Product Management and Product Design organizations. Experience developing B2B or B2B2C products involving enterprise customers, strategic partners, operators, and end consumers. Experience building products that integrate hardware, software, data, operational tooling, and customer-facing experiences. Experience developing products or platforms that support fleet operations, marketplaces, logistics, last-mile delivery, or other high-volume operational environments. Experience scaling product organizations through periods of rapid company growth and changing business priorities. Experience commercializing emerging technology and translating technically sophisticated capabilities into clear customer value. Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, design, business, or a related field. Advanced degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

opportunities.description: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role This position sits within Ramp’s Channel team and reports to Partner Consulting. In this role, you’ll build and scale Ramp’s long-term System Integrator (SI)-led implementation program. You’ll enable a broad ecosystem of implementation partners to support a meaningful volume of Ramp-referred customers, deliver high-quality implementations, and extend the capacity of Ramp’s Customer Success organization. Ramp’s current SI pilot is the starting point - not the end state. You’ll translate the pilot’s learnings into the operating model, technical readiness, commercial foundations, and quality controls required to scale responsibly from an initial cohort to a broad network of partners across products, ERP ecosystems, and geographies. You’ll be Ramp’s technical and programmatic owner for SI delivery: enabling partners to implement Ramp successfully, defining clear scope and certification standards, measuring implementation quality and customer outcomes, and turning field learnings into improvements across product, enablement, and partner strategy. This is a senior IC role, not a people-management role. You’ll need equal credibility in technical implementation conversations and commercial partner-program design, working closely with Channel Partner Managers, Solutions, Customer Success, Product, Product Operations, Accounting Integrations, Legal, Security, and Finance. What You'll Do Build and scale the SI operating model, including partner segmentation, certification tiers, service packages, implementation methodology, scope boundaries, escalation paths, quality standards, and performance management. Own partner readiness and technical enablement across Ramp configuration, ERP integrations, data migration, testing, cutover, and customer change management - defining what partners can deliver independently, when Ramp co-delivery is required, and what remains out of scope. Serve as the first-line technical strategist for SI partners: resolve standard implementation and integration questions, orchestrate specialist support for true exceptions, and convert recurring issues into scalable playbooks, training, or product feedback. Establish the delivery-quality and performance system for the program, including implementation reviews, certification gates, QBRs, customer feedback loops, remediation plans, and reporting on time-to-live, activation, CSAT, rework, capacity, cost-to-serve, and partner-sourced or partner-influenced pipeline. Design the commercial and capacity model in partnership with Channel and Finance, including fixed fees, milestone-based payouts, accelerators, partner capacity commitments, joint business planning, and the program economics required to scale sustainably. Lead responsible program expansion across new products, ERP ecosystems, and geographies; set readiness gates for complex offerings such as Procurement, and influence Product, Product Operations, Product Marketing, and Accounting Integrations using structured field feedback. What You Need Significant senior-level experience scaling an implementation, services, or partner-delivery motion from pilot through repeatable multi-partner execution. Experience in a partner-ecosystem-dependent technology business, such as ERP, accounting, finance operations, procurement, or enterprise SaaS or at a systems integrator/consulting firm that implements those platforms. Demonstrated ownership of implementation quality and customer outcomes, including scope control, partner certification, delivery QA, and escalation governance. Technical fluency to lead credible conversations about integrations, configuration, data migration, ERP workflows, and implementation design; engineering depth is not required, but sound judgment on when to engage specialists is. Commercial judgment to design partner packages, incentives, capacity commitments, payout structures, and guardrails that protect customer outcomes and program economics. Ability to build 0-to-1 operating mechanisms and trusted senior relationships across a diverse partner ecosystem - from specialized regional SIs to global strategic consultancies - including the confidence to challenge partners and internal stakeholders when delivery readiness is insufficient. Nice to Have Experience building or scaling a white-label, staff-augmentation, or outcome-based services model. Experience with Card, Bill Pay, Procurement, AP automation, ERP integrations, multi-entity environments, or global finance operations. Experience expanding an SI/channel program across North America and international markets. Prior 0-to-1 partner-program or services-program experience. What Success Looks Like Establish the SI operating model, including partner readiness, certification, service packages, quality standards, escalation paths, and reporting. Enable existing partners to deliver the supported scope with greater independence, predictable quality, and a commercial model tied to verified milestones and customer outcomes. Publish a data-backed expansion plan across products, ERP ecosystems, and regions, with clear readiness gates for complex offerings such as Procurement. Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global) Flexible PTO Centralized home-office equipment ordering Health and wellness stipend Budget for intra-office travel Weekly coffee stipend United States 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents One Medical annual membership 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay Pet insurance In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) Canada Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life Life, AD&D, and disability coverage Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP) Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health United Kingdom Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay Referral Instructions If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. opportunities.description: Role Description Defense Unicorns gets mission-critical software to the warfighter faster and more securely. Revenue Operations is what keeps the go-to-market team moving at that speed without losing track of the details. As Director of Revenue Operations, you own the systems, data, and processes our sales, solutions architecture, and customer success teams rely on every day. This is a hands-on role, not a reporting desk. You will sit close to revenue leadership and the deals themselves, from first pipeline through close, renewal, and expansion, and you will bring order to a fast-growing environment without getting in its way. Responsibilities CRM and Revenue Systems Own HubSpot as primary administrator: data integrity, pipeline hygiene, and adoption across the go-to-market team. Maintain the deal pipelines (Direct Opportunities, Competitive Solicitations, Renewals) with consistent stages, required fields, and automation. Manage integrations between HubSpot and the tools around it (Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and others). Keep deal data clean and usable: naming conventions, MEDDPICC qualification fields (Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, Competition), D&F dates, DRB data, product feature tags, and ARR calculations. Pipeline Analytics and Forecasting Run the quarterly forecast process between sellers and revenue leadership, and surface where coverage is thin and where the upside is. Maintain forecast models built on pipeline stage, PWIN, deal velocity, and past conversion rates. Give leadership the analytics they need at the deal and portfolio level: coverage ratios, pipeline aging, and win/loss patterns. Flag pipeline and deal risk early, before it shows up in the number. Go-to-Market Process Work with sales and solutions architecture leadership to document and sharpen the sales process, from qualified opportunity through Focused Discovery, Deal Review Board (DRB), scoping, proposal, and close. Set up lead routing, territory and account assignment, and clean handoffs between sales and marketing. Run the cadence for pipeline reviews, QBRs, and annual planning. Support competitive solicitations: opportunity tracking, bid/no-bid analysis, and capture management. Quoting, Pricing, and Revenue Tracking Run deal desk operations covering pricing, discounting, contract structure, and approvals. Maintain SKU-level pricing across UDS Premium, Application Licenses, Edge Node Licenses, Software Factory, SRE Operations, PaaS, and training and services. Work with Finance on bookings recognition, ARR tracking, and revenue reporting. Enablement and Adoption Improve CRM adoption and data quality through training, clear documentation, and follow-through. Build the playbooks, templates, and automation that take busywork off sellers and solution architects. Get new revenue team members up to speed on the systems and the process. What Success Looks Like Leadership trusts the pipeline and forecast numbers in weekly Huddles and QBRs because there is one place to find them. The sales team follows one documented process, and so does solutions architecture. The forecast lands within an agreed tolerance quarter after quarter, with risk flagged early. Deals move from quote to close faster, without cutting corners on approvals. Preferred Experience and Qualifications 7+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations, ideally in GovTech. Hands-on HubSpot experience (Sales Hub, Operations Hub), including workflow automation, custom objects, and reporting. Track record of standing up sales processes in high-growth companies with long, multi-stakeholder deal cycles. Comfortable building pipeline models, forecasts, and the dashboards leadership actually reads. Deal desk or CPQ experience, including pricing and approval workflows. Familiarity with a structured qualification methodology like MEDDPICC, and the discipline to make it stick in the CRM. Strong cross-functional communicator who works well with sales, finance, legal, and product. Self-directed, and at home in a remote-first company with little hierarchy. Background in defense technology, GovTech, or selling to the U.S. Department of Defense. Working knowledge of government procurement (competitive solicitations, contract vehicles, FAR/DFARS). Exposure to product-led and open-source go-to-market models. Experience across both direct and channel/partner sales. Some exposure to solutions architecture or technical pre-sales. A consulting or advisory background (management consulting, GTM/RevOps advisory, Big 4, or a boutique strategy firm) is a real plus. We like operators who can take an ambiguous problem, give it structure, and get it done across a lot of stakeholders. Compensation & Benefits We offer competitive pay, meaningful equity, and full benefits. Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive; additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. Travel Expectations: 4 to 12 times per year (sales training and participation activities) Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States. Remote - USA $204,000—$276,000 USD Who We Are Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market. What We Do We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily. Who We Serve Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products. What We Work On Kubernetes Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure) Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi) Continuous Delivery and automation tooling GitOps Containers CNCF projects and open source products and packages Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping Building and improving security delivery Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy Health: Medical/Dental/Vision Premiums are 100% Company Paid Health Savings Account Life Insurance Disability Insurance Financial: 401k Retirement Plan Company Stock Options Home Office Budget Leave: We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s Paid Parental Leave Learning: Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees) Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. opportunities.title: Senior Product Designer
opportunities.source: Jobicy Public API — Trabajos Remotos Globales
opportunities.description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The Role As a Senior Product Designer at RevenueCat, you’ll own complex product problems from discovery through production. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering to understand customers, identify opportunities, shape what we build and why, and turn technically complex workflows into simple, polished experiences for developers. You’ll join a small design team with a high bar for interaction and visual craft. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, talks directly to customers, prototypes and iterates quickly, and stays involved until the work is shipped and working well in production. About you You have a strong track record solving complex product problems in B2B, SaaS, developer tools, or similarly complex environments. You can frame ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, make sound trade-offs, and help shape what gets built and why. You design clear, intuitive workflows and think carefully about information architecture, states, edge cases, errors, and interactions. You have a high visual craft bar and care deeply about hierarchy, typography, spacing, composition, and polish. You stay close to customers, using direct conversations and qualitative and quantitative evidence to inform your decisions. You work closely with Product and Engineering, involve partners early, reduce scope intelligently, and stay engaged through implementation and follow-up. You communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment and take ownership beyond the boundaries of a design handoff. You understand technical constraints well enough to make realistic decisions and are comfortable using prototypes, code, or modern AI tools when they help you learn or move faster. You are excited about our mission to help developers make more money. In the first month, you'll Get to know our product, customers, and teams. Familiarize yourself with our design system and visual language. Talk to some customers to understand their needs. Start engaging in discovery and design for your first meaningful project. Within the first 3 months, you'll Have taken full ownership of all design aspects for your cross-functional product team. Have seen the first project shipped that you worked on from ideation to launch. Work with your team to discover opportunities and solutions to deliver value to our customers. Within the first 6 months, you'll Be an integral product partner within your cross-functional team, helping shape priorities and product direction. Raise the bar for interaction and visual craft within your area while contributing patterns and improvements that benefit the broader product. Contribute to the development of the design practice at RevenueCat through critique, shared patterns, and collaboration with the rest of the design team. Within the first 12 months, you'll Have shipped meaningful product improvements end to end, from identifying the opportunity through implementation and iteration. Help improve reusable patterns, systems, and ways of working that make the design team more effective without adding unnecessary process. Be a strong advocate for customer understanding, product quality, and thoughtful design across RevenueCat. What we offer: Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator 10-year window to exercise vested equity options A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually Paid desk at a co-working space Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend Interviewing at RevenueCat Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed. More on how we work: How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team The values that guide how we work: Our Values How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

opportunities.title: Coaching.com: Customer Success Manager (UK)
opportunities.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://coaching.com

Customer Success Manager (UK)

General Information

   

Department

Customer Success

Reports to

Director of Customer Success

Location

Remote, UK

Start Date

Immediate

Compensation

£55,000 - £60,000 + quarterly performance bonus*

 

About Coaching.com

Coaching.com is the platform powering the global coaching industry.

Our technology helps organizations, coaching companies, and professional coaches manage and scale coaching, from program administration and coach management to participant engagement, reporting, and more.

We work with leading organizations and coaching providers around the world to make high-quality coaching easier to deliver, manage, and scale.

The Role

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded Customer Success Manager to own and strengthen relationships with our Enterprise customers and strategic partners.

You will guide customers from onboarding and implementation through adoption, ongoing success, renewal, and expansion. Your goal is not simply to help customers use the Coaching.com platform. It is to understand what they are trying to accomplish and help them use our technology successfully to achieve it.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders at leading organizations and coaching companies, becoming a trusted partner who understands their goals, anticipates challenges, identifies opportunities, and ensures they receive meaningful value from Coaching.com.

This is an opportunity for someone who loves the intersection of technology, relationships, problem-solving, and business growth and wants to help shape an evolving Customer Success function within a growing SaaS organization.

What You'll Own

Customer Relationships & Success

  • Serve as the primary strategic point of contact for a portfolio of Enterprise customers and partners.

  • Develop a strong understanding of each customer's goals, use cases, stakeholders, and measures of success.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including senior and executive-level leaders.

  • Proactively guide customers toward stronger adoption, engagement, and outcomes throughout their lifecycle.

Onboarding, Training & Adoption

  • Lead customer onboarding and platform implementation to create a strong first experience with Coaching.com.

  • Deliver engaging virtual training, demonstrations, and enablement sessions for administrators and stakeholders.

  • Help customers translate their business needs into effective platform workflows and practices.

  • Monitor adoption and proactively identify opportunities to help customers gain greater value from the platform.

Retention & Account Growth

  • Own customer health and proactively identify risks before they become renewal concerns.

  • Partner with customers throughout the lifecycle to support strong retention and successful renewals.

  • Identify opportunities for account expansion, additional platform usage, and relevant Coaching.com solutions.

  • Work collaboratively with Sales and internal teams to support expansion and cross-sell opportunities.



Customer Advocacy & Product Partnership

  • Represent the voice of the customer internally.

  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback, needs, and recurring challenges.

  • Partner closely with Product, Support, Sales, and other teams to improve both the platform and overall customer experience.

  • Help identify patterns and opportunities that can improve the experience across the broader customer base.

Customer Success Excellence

  • Maintain accurate account information, activity, opportunities, risks, and next steps within our CRM and Customer Success systems.

  • Use customer data, engagement signals, and business context to prioritize proactive outreach.

  • Contribute to scalable Customer Success processes, resources, webinars, and customer education.

  • Help us continually improve how Coaching.com delivers an exceptional customer experience.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role within a technology or SaaS organization.

  • Experience managing ongoing B2B customer relationships, ideally including Enterprise accounts.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with senior and executive-level stakeholders.

  • Excellent presentation, facilitation, and virtual communication skills.

  • Ability to learn technology quickly and confidently guide customers through software workflows and solutions.

  • Strong commercial awareness with an understanding of retention, expansion, churn, adoption, and account health.

  • Proactive and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple customers, priorities, and projects simultaneously.

  • Comfortable using data and customer insights to identify risks and opportunities.

  • Experience with CRM and customer communication platforms such as HubSpot and Intercom.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and team members take ownership beyond narrowly defined responsibilities.

  • A genuine desire to become an expert in the Coaching.com platform and a trusted resource for customers.

  • Self-directed and resourceful. You do not wait for a customer problem to become urgent before taking action.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with Enterprise SaaS customers.

  • Experience in HRTech, Learning & Development, coaching, talent development, or professional services.

  • Experience working successfully within a distributed or remote team.

  • Experience supporting software implementations, onboarding, or change management.

How We Define Success

Success in this role means your customers are not simply using Coaching.com. They are getting measurable value from it.

You will help drive:

  • Strong customer adoption and engagement

  • Successful onboarding and implementation

  • Healthy Enterprise relationships

  • High retention and renewal rates

  • Identification of expansion opportunities

  • Strong customer advocacy and satisfaction

  • Clear, actionable customer insights that improve our product and experience

How to Apply

Please send the following to careers@coaching.com with the subject line Customer Success Manager - UK:

  1. Your resume

  2. A short cover letter
    In 2 to 3 paragraphs, tell us why you are interested in Coaching.com and what makes you a strong fit for this position.

  3. A short video introduction

Part of this role involves interacting with senior executives, Enterprise partners, and prospective clients, primarily through virtual meetings. You should be confident, professional, and comfortable communicating on camera.

Please record a short video of approximately 2 minutes answering the following questions:

  • What is one thing you've learned about Coaching.com that stood out to you?

  • Why are you excited about this opportunity?

  • What strengths or experience would you bring that would help you succeed in this role?

Upload your video to Google Drive and include a shareable link with your application. Please confirm that the sharing permissions allow our team to view it.

Equal Opportunity

Coaching.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on merit, competence, and qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin or ethnicity, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/coaching-com-customer-success-manager-uk

opportunities.title: Big Bear Vacations: Owner Retention Specialist
opportunities.description:
Headquarters: Big Bear Lake, California, USA
URL: https://www.bigbearvacations.com/

OWNER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Department: Owner Relations / Owner Experience
Market: Puerto Vallarta & Nuevo Vallarta, Mexico
Reports To: Director of Owner Relations
Employment Type: Contractor
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Monday - Saturday
Compensation: USD $1,200 monthly
Languages: Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken — required

Position Purpose

The Owner Experience Specialist is the primary point of contact between Naya Homes and our homeowners in Puerto Vallarta and Nuevo Vallarta.

This role is responsible for building and maintaining strong, consistent, and proactive relationships with homeowners in order to support owner satisfaction and retention. Rather than simply reacting to problems after they occur, the Specialist is expected to identify potential concerns early and address them before they become reasons for an owner to consider terminating their relationship with Naya Homes.

The Specialist owns three key outcomes: executing the required owner communication cadence under the 33-Touch Relationship Model; providing homeowners with clear visibility into the condition and performance of their properties; and capturing property content that supports marketing efforts, social media, and owner communication.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, proactive, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a high volume of daily communication while maintaining accurate documentation and consistent follow-up.

Fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken, is an indispensable requirement for this position. The Specialist will communicate with homeowners and internal teams in both languages.

Because this is a remote contractor position, the primary focus is on achieving established goals, service standards, and KPIs. The schedule may be flexible as needed to ensure objectives are met, while maintaining the required availability and responsiveness for homeowners and the business.

Core Responsibilities

1. Owner Relationship Management & Communication

  • Execute 20–25 documented owner interactions per day through calls, email, and text.

  • Maintain 100% completion of required monthly touches for every assigned owner under the 33-Touch Relationship Model.

  • Maintain a balance across the three touch types:

    • Property Visibility: condition updates, inspection findings, photos, and property content.

    • Personal Relationship: relationship-building communication not directly related to a transaction or problem.

    • Informative / Value-Driven: performance, pricing, market conditions, and seasonal outlook.

  • Enter every interaction with a clear purpose and conclude it with a defined next step.

  • Complete scheduled owner check-in calls on the day they are due and rebook any rescheduled calls before the end of the same business day.

  • Maintain clear communication regarding availability, support, and expected response times so owners always know who to contact and when they can expect an answer.

  • Build trust and maintain professional, long-term relationships with homeowners.

2. Property Visibility & Owner Updates

  • Collect property updates from Operations, Housekeeping, Maintenance, and inspection reports.

  • Review condition notes and available photos before communicating with owners to ensure updates are specific and accurate.

  • Translate operational findings into clear, plain-language owner updates, including what was found, what action is being taken, associated costs, and expected resolution timelines.

  • Respond to all open owner conversations regarding work orders.

  • Ensure that no work order is dispatched to an owner's property without documented owner approval.

  • Ensure that every unresolved property issue has a clearly assigned next action and responsible person.

  • Provide owners with meaningful visibility into the work being performed on their property.

3. Escalation & Churn Risk Identification

  • Identify early signs of owner dissatisfaction or potential churn, including declining sentiment, slow or short responses, revenue complaints, recurring property condition issues, questions regarding contract terms, or references to other management companies.

  • Escalate concerns on the same business day.

  • Add applicable owners to the Owner Churn Board and keep records current as situations develop.

  • Confirm ownership of the next action for every escalation and ensure each open case has a clearly assigned responsible person.

  • Communicate potential risks early rather than waiting for issues to escalate.

4. Documentation & CRM Discipline

  • Log every owner interaction in Monday.com on the same day it occurs.

  • Maintain the Owner Churn Board on a daily basis.

  • Schedule all future owner touches and follow-ups before closing out the day.

  • Prepare a clear next-day action list before logging off.

  • Complete a weekly CRM documentation self-audit and correct any gaps identified.

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records of all owner communications.

Daily Operating Rhythm

Start of Day

  • Log into RingCentral and Monday.com.

  • Review the Owner Engagement Tracker.

  • Identify owners due for required touches.

  • Review notes from inspections, maintenance, turnovers, and operations.

  • Flag owners with open concerns, negative or declining sentiment, or recent performance or condition issues.

During the Day

  • Complete scheduled owner check-in calls.

  • Send required emails and text messages.

  • Complete scheduled property-content activities remotely or through available internal resources.

  • Collect and communicate relevant property updates.

  • Respond to open work order conversations.

  • Escalate concerns on the same business day.

  • Maintain consistent follow-up with assigned homeowners.

End of Day

  • Ensure all owner interactions are documented in Monday.com.

  • Update the Owner Churn Board.

  • Schedule future touches and follow-ups.

  • Confirm that there are zero undocumented conversations.

  • Prepare the next-day action list.

Weekly Close

  • Maintain 100% progress toward required monthly owner touches.

  • Ensure there are no missed follow-ups.

  • Complete the CRM documentation self-audit.

  • Review owner sentiment trends.

  • Identify unresolved owner issues requiring attention.

  • Identify owners requiring proactive outreach during the following week.

Performance Standards & KPIs

Performance will be measured monthly against the following targets:

  • Daily owner touches: 20–25 per day.

  • Required monthly touch completion: 100%.

  • Documentation accuracy: 95% or higher.

  • Undocumented conversations: Zero.

  • Same-day escalation compliance: 100%.

  • Overdue escalations beyond SLA: Zero.

  • Owner sentiment trend: Stable or improving.

  • Overall KPI attainment: 90% or higher.

  • Retention saves: Tracked and reviewed through the Owner Churn Board.

Sustained performance below the established targets may result in a documented coaching plan.

Accountability Standards

  • Missed follow-ups are considered a performance issue.

  • Undocumented conversations are considered a performance issue.

  • Dispatching a work order without documented owner approval is considered a performance issue.

  • Early escalation is considered a positive behavior and is recognized accordingly.

  • Proactive communication is an expectation of the role, not an additional benefit or optional activity.

  • The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned conversations, follow-ups, and open issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.

Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken — indispensable.

  • 2+ years of experience in client-facing account management, hospitality, property management, customer success, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience working independently and managing responsibilities in a remote environment.

  • Strong CRM discipline and a proven track record of documenting work consistently without requiring constant follow-up.

  • Comfortable initiating a high volume of outbound calls and handling difficult conversations directly and professionally.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.

opportunities.title: B2spin: Digital Design Team Lead — Retention/CRM
opportunities.description:
Headquarters: Bulgaria
URL: http://b2spin.com

We are B2Spin, and we are dedicated to delivering the best Free-to-Play Social Casino and gaming experiences by creating captivating, engaging, and unique products that are accessible to everyone. We have built a team of talented professionals from all over the globe, who are working to continually improve the experiences of our players. We are not looking to just be part of the industry, but to revolutionize it.

The Role

We run the creative function for retention at a multi-brand iGaming company. That means high-volume, high-frequency output — emails, push notifications, in-app messages, onsite banners — produced for segmented player audiences across multiple brands, all at the same time. This is a marketing creative leadership role, not a product or UX design role. You will lead a team of Digital Designers producing retention marketing assets across four brands and multiple CRM channels — not app or product interfaces.

The Design Team Lead owns the quality and consistency of that output. Not by reviewing everything personally, but by building the systems, standards, and team capability that make good work the default. This is as much an ops-and-systems role as it is a creative leadership role. If you're energized by turning "we eyeball it every time" into "we have a standard for that," this is the job.

 
 

What You Will Own

Brand systems that actually get used

Our brands are fragmented today. You'll build the documented visual systems — templates, component libraries, per-brand rules, practical "do this, not that" guidance — that designers reach for rather than work around. When the system is good, consistency stops being something we police and becomes the default.

Repeatable production at scale

Multiple designers producing work across four brands and CRM channels need modular templates, clear briefing standards, and clean versioning. You'll build and maintain those foundations. Just as importantly, you'll convert the feedback you keep repeating into checklists and onboarding material — so nobody gives the same note twice.

AI that produces on-brand results, not surprises

We already use AI heavily; the results aren't predictable enough. You'll put structure around it: per-brand prompt libraries, locked reference styles, clear review checkpoints, and training on how to take a raw AI output and finish it to a genuinely on-brand standard.

Quality that can be measured

You'll define what "on-brand and high quality" means for each brand, track simple signals like first-pass approval rate and rework volume, and catch delivery or quality risks before they hit send dates. You'll also keep improving how the team works — processes, tools, handovers — without waiting to be asked.

A team that feels clear and supported

Regular 1:1s, honest consistent feedback, and being the person designers come to when they're stuck. You'll monitor workload alongside the Traffic Manager, contribute to hiring, and make sure new designers land well and ramp fast.

 
 

What Success Looks Like

  • Our brands feel like systems, and the work looks consistent wherever it shows up.

  • Designers work to shared standards, so the same feedback isn't going round in circles.

  • Work ships with reliable quality and far less rework.

  • AI is a dependable part of how we create, not a gamble.

  • The team feels supported, knows what good looks like, and trusts their own judgement.

 
 

What We’re Looking For

  • A direct, easy communicator who does well in a fast-moving, remote team.

  • 5+ years of professional digital design experience, with a strong portfolio of digital work.

  • A track record of building systems, such as templates, brand guidelines, component libraries, or repeatable processes, not just strong one-off work.

  • Experience mentoring or supporting other designers; leadership is a big plus, not a must.

  • A sharp eye for detail and the ability to give feedback that is clear, kind, and useful.

  • Hands-on experience taming AI creative tools, or a strong point of view on how you would.

Why you will love it

You'll thrive in our high-pace, high-growth environment where your curiosity directly shapes million-dollar decisions. Every insight you uncover translates into real business impact, while you build and lead a team that thinks strategically about the brands they own. You'll have the freedom to innovate your approach to analysis while working at the cutting edge of gaming analytics and machine learning.

Equal Opportunities Statement
We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking.
Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

opportunities.description:

Description

CRM Marketing Manager

Reporting to: CMO
Location: Fully Remote
Markets: 12

About the Role

We are looking for a CRM Marketing Manager to own CXM’s customer lifecycle marketing across 12 markets. You will use customer data, segmentation, automation, and personalised communications to improve activation, first-time deposits, retention, reactivation, and customer lifetime value.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build CRM journeys from the ground up, manage campaigns across multiple markets, and use performance data to continuously improve results.

Key Objectives

  • Build and launch at least 3 automated lifecycle journeys covering welcome/activation, retention, and reactivation within the first 6 months.
  • Improve the current 9% lead-to-FTD conversion rate through targeted CRM activation campaigns.
  • Support reducing churn to below 10% through structured retention and reactivation programmes.
  • Build and maintain localised CRM journeys across all 12 markets.
  • Maintain 99%+ deliverability and ensure all CRM activity meets applicable compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Lifecycle & CRM Strategy

  • Own customer journeys across onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, loyalty, VIP, churn prevention, and win-back.
  • Define triggers, audiences, journey logic, exclusions, frequency caps, and exit criteria.
  • Coordinate email and push communications to create a consistent customer experience.

Campaigns & Automation

  • Build, launch, and optimise automated CRM campaigns using platforms such as Mailgun, Braze, Klaviyo, or equivalent.
  • Create targeted campaigns based on customer behaviour, lifecycle stage, market, language, and product.
  • Manage promotional campaigns, newsletters, VIP communications, retention campaigns, and partner communications.
  • Develop and maintain reusable email templates and content blocks.

Segmentation & Personalisation

  • Build and maintain customer segments, consent lists, exclusions, and communication rules.
  • Configure personalised and dynamic content based on customer data.
  • Work with Product, Analytics, and IT to define and validate data and event requirements.
  • SQL knowledge is a strong advantage.

Localisation

  • Manage CRM communications across multiple languages and markets.
  • Coordinate translation, editing, and linguistic QA.
  • Ensure correct currencies, dates, links, variables, legal messaging, tone, and RTL requirements.
  • Maintain master journeys and localisation matrices across all markets.

Deliverability & Compliance

  • Monitor deliverability, bounces, spam complaints, suppression lists, and domain/IP reputation.
  • Maintain strong email hygiene and deliverability standards.
  • Run detailed pre-launch QA covering audiences, links, variables, tracking, content, sender details, and scheduling.
  • Ensure campaigns comply with consent, unsubscribe, data retention, and local regulatory requirements.

Analytics & Optimisation

  • Analyse CRM performance by market, language, segment, and customer lifecycle stage.
  • Measure conversion, retention, churn, revenue, and incremental uplift — not just opens and clicks.
  • Run A/B and holdout tests across offers, messaging, timing, frequency, channels, and journey structure.
  • Maintain a clear optimisation backlog and turn insights into measurable improvements.


Requirements
  • Proven experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, email marketing, or marketing automation.
  • Hands-on experience building automated customer journeys.
  • Strong understanding of segmentation, personalisation, triggers, and lifecycle strategy.
  • Experience managing CRM across multiple markets and languages.
  • Strong knowledge of email deliverability and campaign QA.
  • Experience with Mailgun, Braze, Klaviyo, or similar CRM platforms.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset.
  • Comfortable working with technical and data teams.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Experience in FX, fintech, trading, igaming, or another regulated B2C environment is highly desirable.
  • Able to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Ideal Candidate Background

The strongest candidates are likely to be currently working as a:

  • CRM Manager / Lifecycle Marketing Manager
  • Email Marketing Manager
  • Marketing Automation Specialist
  • Retention Marketing Manager
  • CRM-focused Digital Marketing Manager

Experience with high-volume B2C customer journeys, FTD/conversion funnels, retention, reactivation, and regulated markets will be particularly valuable.



Benefits

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working with minimal meeting overhead.
  • Ownership of CRM across 12 international markets.
  • Genuine opportunity to build and improve the customer lifecycle function.
  • An established business with the resources and budget to execute ambitious CRM initiatives.
  • Freedom to test, learn, and implement new ideas.
  • Competitive, above-market compensation.
  • KPI-linked bonus connected directly to CRM and business performance.

Recruitment Process

Stage 1: HR interview — experience, motivation, and fit.
Stage 2: CMO interview — CRM expertise, strategy, and relevant experience.
Stage 3: CEO interview, where required.

opportunities.title: Glean: AI Success Manager, Central
opportunities.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

About Glean:
 
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
 
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
 
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
 
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
 
About the Role:
 
As an AI Success Manager (AISM), you will serve as the primary post-sales point of contact, accountable for platform health. The AISM is a hands-on role where you will lead and orchestrate successful implementations and long-term customer engagements, making our customers wildly successful. You will be responsible for ensuring efficient technical deployment, delivering proactive strategic guidance, and building, then delivering against, joint success plans and EBRs. AISMs collaborate closely with Account Executives, AI Outcomes Managers, Solution Architects, Support, and R&D on scoped engagements.
 
You will:
  • Help our customers achieve real business outcomes through the use of AI
  • Serve as the primary lead on new customer deployments including hands on guidance for the setup of SSO and connectors 
  • Own the end-to-end delivery from kickoff to go-live through renewal, ensuring clarity on expectations, timeline, and services budget for all stakeholders.
  • Create and execute joint success plans and EBRs that drive additional adoption, deepen engagement, and result in measurable business value.
  • Provide overall program management.
  • Develop, communicate, and execute tailored project plans; facilitate cross-functional collaboration across delivery, operations, and technical teams.
  • Provide a blend of technical guidance and strategic partnership, acting as escalation manager when necessary.
  • Monitor and report on deployment progress, customer adoption, and satisfaction metrics.
  • Proactively identify risks or blockers and drive resolution—escalating internally when appropriate.
  • Guide and document improvements for onboarding processes, playbooks, and best practices.
  • Contribute to continuous process and product improvements by providing actionable feedback and participating in internal initiatives
About you:
  • 3–5 years of experience in technical deployment, implementation management, technical customer success, or technical account management of SaaS products for enterprise customers.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycles and methodologies, including Agile and DevOps practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and related services. Certification preferred.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on troubleshooting technical issues as well as building consensus around outcomes and success measures.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and communication abilities.
  • Proven experience serving enterprise clients in strategic, consultative, and tactical, hands-on roles.
  • Experience with process documentation, playbooks, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Solutions-oriented mindset; trusted advisor with the capability to own escalations.
  • Capable of handling ambiguity and thriving in a fast-paced environment.
Location: 
  • This role is remote (must be located in US Central timezone)

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard OTE range for this position is $120,000-$170,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-REMOTE

 
AI-First Mindset at Glean:
 
At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

About Prove

Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.   

Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team! 

Director, Sales Compensation

Department: Revenue Operations

FLSA: Status: Exempt

Location: New York, NY, Remote West Coast

Overview

At our rapidly growing company, we are seeking an exceptional Director of Sales Compensation to lead the design, implementation, and stewardship of our complex commission plans. This strategic role is pivotal in ensuring our compensation programs align with our overall business objectives, empower and motivate our sales teams, and accurately reflect the unique challenges and opportunities of our consumption-based business model.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned compensation professional who thrives on corporate strategy but possesses an unyielding "roll-up-your-sleeves" attitude toward administrative accuracy. You must be deeply committed to the integrity of the data, showing a willingness to inspect every statement in detail while maintaining the agility to pivot tools and processes at a moment's notice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Planning & GTM Alignment:
    • Design, implement, and administer comprehensive sales commission plans for over 100 employees across Sales, Customer Success, Sales Engineering and other departments.
    • Partner closely with the SVP of Revenue Operations, Sales Leaders, and Finance to model, forecast, and align compensation strategies with our overarching GTM objectives.
    • Assess the operational feasibility of proposed plans, ensuring that what is designed strategically can be accurately administered at scale.
  • Team Leadership:
    • Directly manage, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of two compensation professionals, overseeing their daily workflows, monthly deliverables, and professional growth.

Process Automation & AI Innovation:

    • Leverage compensation tools and technology to streamline processes, automate commission calculations, and improve overall operational efficiency.
    • Actively identify opportunities to utilize Artificial Intelligence (AI) to automate manual workflows, reconcile complex datasets, and accelerate the validation of commission outputs.

Standardized Reporting & Analytics:

    • Design, build, and standardize rigorous monthly and quarterly reporting packages tailored for Finance and Sales Leadership to track commission spend, budget variances, and plan effectiveness.
    • Gather and analyze sales data, performance metrics, and revenue trends to deliver data-driven insights and actionable recommendations for future plan modifications.
  • Meticulous Administration & Audit:
    • Oversee the monthly commission cycle with an elite standard of accuracy, including a commitment to personally review every single employee's statement in detail each month.
    • Master our primary commission tool (CaptivateIQ), while maintaining the architectural readiness and willingness to transition the entire process at a moment's notice.
    • Ensure all plans remain competitive, equitable, and compliant with relevant financial standards and regulations.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to sellers and sales leadership, creating clear, concise documentation and conducting regular feedback loops (surveys, town halls) to maintain high motivation and transparency.
    • Partner with Finance to establish bulletproof auditing, reconciliation, and expense forecasting workflows.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of dedicated experience in sales compensation design and administration, with a proven track record navigating the complexities of a consumption-based business model.
  • People Management: 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, and evaluating direct reports within a revenue operations or corporate compensation environment.
  • Strategic & Operational Hybrid Mindset: Proven ability to advise senior leadership on GTM strategy, paired with an explicit passion for commissions administration and getting the fine details right.
  • Tools & Technical Agility:
    • Advanced proficiency with commission automation platforms (specifically CaptivateIQ, though experience with Varicent or Xactly is welcome).
    • Practical exposure to utilizing AI tools or advanced automation scripts to streamline manual data reconciliation. (Claude, Gemini)
    • Expert-level Google Sheets / Excel capabilities are mandatory, alongside an operational willingness to manage massive commission infrastructure manually if required.
    • Familiarity with the broader tech stack: Salesforce, Adaptive, Intaact.
  • Education & Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation preferred.
  • Core Skills: Exceptional analytical problem-solving skills, rigorous attention to detail, and top-tier communication skills required to manage cross-functional stakeholders smoothly.

opportunities.description:

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) 

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default 
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds 
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

We make a positive impact.

We aim for the stars.

We care for each other. 

Impact of a Customer Retention Manager

As our Customer Retention Manager, you play a key role in protecting and growing revenue across a high-volume portfolio of customer accounts. Your day-to-day is proactive, human outreach and health monitoring — building real relationships at scale, bringing a human touch to segments that are often managed purely through automation, and catching risk early. When you manage that well, renewal conversations become a natural next step rather than the main event. You'll also work within the workflows, health scoring, automation, and segmentation that let retention scale without creating internal chaos, all while keeping the renewal experience smart, timely, and low-friction.

Reporting to our VP, Customer Success, this role is ideal for someone who loves building, improving processes, testing ideas, and seeing direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to inform retention strategy and engagement models across the business.

What to expect

  • Renewal Ownership & Pipeline Management: Manage a rolling pipeline of customer renewals across a high-volume portfolio, initiating conversations ahead of contract expiration and driving each account through to close.

  • Retention Workflow Support: Help build and improve scalable retention and renewal workflows using Salesforce and integrated tooling, contributing to repeatable processes that hold up as portfolio volume grows.

  • Proactive Relationship Building: Own direct, human outreach to smaller and long-tail accounts by proactively building relationships with them.

  • Lifecycle & Tech-Touch Design: Contribute to the design of customer lifecycle journeys, engagement triggers, and tech-touch motions 

  • Health Scoring & Risk Identification: Use customer health scoring frameworks- built on usage, engagement, and lifecycle signals- to identify at-risk accounts early, partnering with internal stakeholders to develop and execute save strategies.

  • Automation & AI Enablement: Support the implementation of automated outreach, lifecycle campaigns, and renewal risk workflows, and flag opportunities to leverage AI and automation.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and multi-year agreements within established company guidelines.

  • Expansion Identification: Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Executives to identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities during the renewal cycle.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to support and inform retention strategy and customer engagement models.

What you bring

  • Renewal Lifecycle Experience: Experience managing a rolling renewal pipeline, engaging customers well in advance of contract expiration.

  • Commercial Negotiation Skills: Experience negotiating pricing, contract terms, and multi-year agreements within established guidelines.

  • Risk Identification & Save Strategy: Ability to identify at-risk accounts early and collaborate cross-functionally on save strategies.

You belong here

About the Role

As a Customer Success Manager at Abnormal AI, you will serve as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, focusing on successful onboarding, adoption, and ongoing value delivery. Description

Keeper is hiring a passionate B2B Customer Support Representative to contribute knowledge and expertise to our B2B Support team. This can be a 100% remote position from select locations with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally.  Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while providing best-in-class technical support to Keeper customers.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is transforming cybersecurity for people and organizations globally. Keeper’s intuitive solutions are built with end-to-end encryption to protect every user, on every device, in every location. Our zero-trust privileged access management platform deploys in minutes and seamlessly integrates with any tech stack to prevent breaches, reduce help desk costs and ensure compliance. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of organizations, Keeper is the leader for password, passkey and secrets management, privileged access, secure remote access and encrypted messaging. As a B2B Customer Support Representative with Keeper, you will handle client requests and feedback via phone and email through Salesforce (including technical troubleshooting and real time assistance).
